diagnosis: The server-streaming gRPC endpoint subscribeDeviceTelemetry, bridged to web clients via Envoy's gRPC-Web proxy, subscribes to a Redis telemetry channel matching call.request.device_id. It performs no authorization checks against caller account claims to determine if the target IoT device is registered to the user's facility. An attacker can stream real-time operational telemetry from competitor machinery and security sensors.
